questions.question: Paul took Titus, a Greek, with him to Jerusalem. Titus was forced to be circumcised. True or false?
Why did some false brothers sneak in among Paul and his companions during his visit to Jerusalem?

answers.text: To spy on the freedom Paul's group had in Christ
To hear the gospel for themselves
To bring a gift for the leaders

questions.question: When James, Cephas and John accepted Paul and Barnabas in Jerusalem, what did they give them?

answers.text: A letter for all the churches
